description:
Implement a real NVENC encoder backend (not a stub) in helper/src/encoder/backends/nvenc/.

Real probe: cuInit → cuDeviceGetCount → NvEncodeAPICreateInstance → nvEncOpenEncodeSessionEx session creation test. Precise unavailable reasons: no-cuda-driver, cuinit-failed:N, no-cuda-device, no-nvenc-library, nvenc-api-create-failed:N, session-create-failed:N.

Real configure: H.264, CBR ~5Mbps, ~2s GOP, SHM frame input (DMA-BUF deferred). Real push_frame: SHM lock → memcpy → nvEncEncodePicture. Real drain: lock bitstream → read → unlock → EncodedFragment with real H.264 NALs. Real init_segment(): ftyp+moov bytes with SPS/PPS. Real fMP4 moof+mdat output in EncodedFragment.bytes.

Dependencies: Add libloading = "0.8" to helper/Cargo.toml. Update encoder_selection.rs and encoder_session.rs tests.

Hard constraints: Do NOT implement x264. Do NOT modify encoder.selected schema. Do NOT modify capture/segment/export/packaging/Electron files. ProbeOutcome::Available only when session creation actually succeeds. Resolves ISS-002.
title: Implement real NVENC backend (T-017a)
